answer: Ridge-echo willow proof: one $5 ultrasonic sensor per identity, mounted on a named willow at the foot of a surveyed ridge. Each epoch the sensor pings the ridge face and the echo return time goes into the open log. Any neighbour can re-ping that willow and hear the same gap; a forged gap is exposed by a single re-ping, and a copied log carries the same return twice, so both entries are voided. The ridge answers every ping the same way, so a forged echo has nowhere to hide.
